All objectives complete and verified.

## Final Report

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Panel titles on the provisioned dashboard `Service Health` (uid `bench-service-health`, folder `Bench`), exactly as shown on the page:
- `Request rate` (timeseries)
- `Error count` (stat)
- `Latency by endpoint` (table)

Read from the rendered page headings and cross-checked against the dashboard JSON (`/api/dashboards/uid/bench-service-health`), which returned the same three titles.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** New dashboard `c2agr1 Bench Dashboard` exists and is saved (version 3). It contains a Stat panel titled `c2agr1 Availability` whose query uses the TestData data source. Verified in the saved JSON: `"type":"stat"`, `"title":"c2agr1 Availability"`, `"datasource":{"type":"grafana-testdata-datasource","uid":"benchtestdata"}` on both the panel and its target. The panel renders a live value (90.3) from TestData.

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The same dashboard contains a Text panel titled `c2agr1 Notes` with content `"Run c2agr1 bench notes. Availability stat panel uses the TestData data source."` — includes the runid `c2agr1`. Verified in saved JSON (`"type":"text"`, `"mode":"markdown"`) and in the rendered panel text.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Saved JSON contains `"tags":["bench"]` and `"time":{"from":"now-6h","to":"now"}`. The page header shows `Time range selected: Last 6 hours`. Note: persisting the time range required ticking "Update default time range" in the save dialog — the first save silently dropped it.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Saved JSON contains `"refresh":"1m"`. The page header shows `Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected`. As above, this required ticking "Update default refresh value" in the save dialog.

**Objective 6 — DONE.** URL: `http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/efwc2cfy4jif4e/c2agr1-bench-dashboard` — UID `efwc2cfy4jif4e`, slug `c2agr1-bench-dashboard`, dashboard id 3, folder `General`. Confirmed findable via search (`/api/search?query=c2agr1`).

Two notes on the environment worth flagging: Grafana 11.3 has no "Apply" button in the panel editor — changes commit on "Back to dashboard" — and the save dialog's "Update default time range" / "Update default refresh value" checkboxes are what actually persist those two settings; leaving them unchecked saves the dashboard without them.
